rationale: Tests comprehension of a key warning signal — the two-week duration criterion for recognising depressive episodes — directly grounded in the Warning Signals content block.
Anchors recall of the legal right to community living enshrined in the Mental Healthcare Act 2017, a specific provision students must know for programme and rights-based reasoning.
Asks students to distinguish process from outcome indicators in NMHP/DMHP monitoring — an analytic skill essential for programme evaluation and community health practice.
